answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through proofs of space. Entities must allocate unique physical storage to answer periodic challenge queries, forcing an attacker to incur the verifiable cost of dedicated drive capacity per identity. This stops the network from becoming a haven for bot swarms, fracturing an attacker's infrastructure like brittle shale once overhead pushes them over a steep cost ledge. However, enterprise datacenters with bulk hardware gain an unfair economic advantage.
